Tomb]] (28 Jun 1998)}} | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | longest losses = | matches = 210 | total goals = 434 | prevseason = [[1997 Girabola|1997]] | nextseason = [[1999 Girabola|1999]] }} The '''1998 [[Girabola]]''' was the 20th season of top-tier football competition in [[Angola]]. The season began on April 1, 1998. [[C.D. Primeiro de Agosto|Primeiro de Agosto]] were the defending champions. The league comprised 16 teams, the bottom three of which were relegated to the 1999 [[Gira Angola]]. [[C.D. Primeiro de Agosto|Primeiro de Agosto]] were crowned champions, winning their 7th title, while Chicoil, [[Kabuscorp S.C.P.|Kabuscorp]] and SECIL Marítima were relegated. Alberto Ferreira {{a.k.a.}} ''Betinho'' of [[Atlético Petróleos de Luanda|Petro de Luanda]] finished as the top scorer with 14 goals. ==Changes from the 1997 season== '''Relegated:''' [[S.H.
